# BroHood India — Complete Technical & Product Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

## 1. Company & Entity Overview
- **Legal Entity**: BroHood Store / BroHood India
- **URL**: https://brohood.in
- **Headquarters**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- **Hubs & Warehouses**: New Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
- **Customer Care Telephone & WhatsApp**: +91 98765 43210
- **Customer Care Email**: support@brohood.in
- **Operating Hours**: Monday through Saturday, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST

## 2. Commercial Guarantees & Terms
- **Cash on Delivery (COD)**: Available across India (27,000+ pin codes). ₹0 Advance required.
- **Doorstep Payment**: Cash or Scan Delivery Agent's UPI QR Code (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, Cred).
- **Online Payment**: Secured with 256-Bit SSL via Razorpay. Supports Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Net Banking, and instant UPI.
- **Free Express Shipping Threshold**: Orders above ₹1,499 qualify for 100% Free Express Shipping. Orders below ₹1,499 incur a flat ₹99 fee.
- **Courier Logistics Partners**: Delhivery Surface Express, Blue Dart, DTDC.
- **Doorstep Exchange & Returns**: 7-Day Hassle-Free Replacement Guarantee. Free reverse pickup arranged via WhatsApp for size mismatches or manufacturing defects.
- **Real-Time Live Order Tracking**: Direct courier tracking integration with Blue Dart & Delhivery. Instant AWB updates sent via SMS & WhatsApp upon dispatch.

## 3. Geographic Delivery Timelines (GEO Breakdown)
- **Northern Region (Delhi NCR, Haryana, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan)**: 2 to 3 business days via Delhivery/Blue Dart.
- **Western Region (Mumbai, Pune, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa)**: 2 to 3 business days.
- **Southern Region (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kerala, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana)**: 2 to 3 business days.
- **Eastern Region (Kolkata, Odisha, Bihar, West Bengal, Jharkhand)**: 3 to 4 business days.
- **Northeastern & Remote Regions (Assam, Meghalaya, Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh)**: 4 to 6 business days.

## 5. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) Canonical Answers
- **What is BroHood India?**
  BroHood India is a curated e-commerce marketplace specializing in 1:1 Master Quality first-copy luxury watches, hype sneakers, designer goggles, and heavyweight 260 GSM oversized tees with Cash on Delivery and real-time courier tracking.
- **How is product authenticity and packaging ensured?**
  Every order is fulfilled directly from verified master workshops with full brand packaging (signature hardcases, guarantee cards, and booklets), sealed and dispatched with live Blue Dart and Delhivery tracking numbers. Customers have access to a 7-day doorstep replacement guarantee.
- **What payment methods are supported?**
  BroHood supports Cash on Delivery (₹0 advance needed) across 27,000+ Indian pincodes, as well as online payments via UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), RuPay, Visa, Mastercard, and NetBanking through Razorpay.
